d.t: BRACING ARMS FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Brace is a bracing arm to connect two pedestals to increase the stability of a raised flooring installation. Bracing arms are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and is connected to collars around pedestals to prevent individual pedestals from shifting or moving especially during maintenance to ensure accurate reinstallation of pavers. SikaRoof VersiJack Brace is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack and SikaRoof VersiJack Collar to form an adjustable bracing system for centre to centre pedestal distances of 470 - 700 mm.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Bracing arms are used with adjustable pedestals for raised paver flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
